sonnet.problem: This true/false asks again whether the disciples gave the same answer Jesus told them to give. Card 5 already asked what Jesus tells them to say, and verse 34 only repeats that answer, so the fact is asked twice.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Card 3 asks the baker for the title in Luke 19:38 before any story card has told that verse. Card 4 then tells the verse and quotes the answer, so it works as a recap of a question already answered. The choice card jumped ahead of its story card.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
